notes: Transcription of the minutes of the religious colloquy held in Vilnius on 14 June 1585, from a manuscript in the HAB, with a German translation, introduction, manuscript description and digital facsimile. Counts are ours: about 7,800 words in the Latin transcription (TEI file, main text without the footnotes and apparatus). The TEI file was last modified on 7 May 2006 and there is no sign of later changes.
